Northern Sotho: Balemi ba tshephile tshedimošo ye e nepagetšego ka ga tlelaemete gore ba kgone go fokotša diabe tša phetogo ya tlelaemete.
Amharic: የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጽእኖን ለመቀነስ ገበሬዎች ትክክለኛ የአየር ንብረት መረጃ ላይ ይተማመናሉ፡፡

English: Participatory Scenario Planning (PSP) is a way to create climate information for decision-makers and farmers, such as seasonal climate forecasts.
Luganda: Embeera y’Okuteekateeka omuli okwetabamu (PSP) y’engeri y’okutegeka ebikwata ku mbeera y’obudde olw’okuyamba abakola okusalawo n’abalimi, gamba ng’okuteebereza kw’embeera y’obudde mu kiseera ekimu.
Yoruba: Ìwòran Ìṣètò Akópa (PSP) jẹ́ ọ̀nà kan láti ṣe àlàyé nípa ojú-ọjọ́ fún àwọn aláṣẹ àti àwọn àgbẹ̀, lára rẹ̀ ni ṣíṣe àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ àkókó ojú-ọjọ́.
Zulu: I­Participatory Scenario Planning (i-PSP) yindlela yokwenzela abathathizinqumo nabalimi ulwazi lobunjalozwe, olufana neziqagulo zobunjalozwe.
Hausa: Tsare-Tsaren Shiga (PSP) hanya ce ta samar da bayanan yanayi don mahukunta da manoma, kamar hasashen yanayi na yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Peakanyo ya Seemo ka go Kgatha tema (PSP) ke mokgwa wa go hlama tshedimošo ka ga tlelaemete go batšeadiphetho le go balemi, go swnaa le dikakanyo tša tlelaemete tša dihla.
Amharic: አሳታፊ ሁኔታ-ተኮር እቀዳ (አ.ሁ.እ) ለገበሬዎች እና ለውሳኔ ሰጪዎች እንደወቅታዊ የአየር ንብረት ትንበያ የመሳሰሉ የአየር ንብረት መረጃዎችን ለማዘጋጀት የሚጠቅም ዘዴ ነው፡፡

English: Unfortunately PSP still needs to be better integrated into government planning in Malawi.
Luganda: Ebyembi, Embeera y’Okuteekateeka omuli PSP ekyetaaga okussibwa mu nteekateeka za Gavumenti mu Malawi.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láàánú pé PSP ṣì nílò kí wọn ò túnbọ ṣe àlòpọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ètò ìjọba ní Malawi.
Zulu: Ngeshwa, i-PSP isadinga ukuthi ifakwe kangcono ekuhleleni kukahulumeni eMalawi.
Hausa: Abin baƙin ciki shi ne har yanzu PSP yana buƙatar a haɗa shi da kyau cikin shirin gwamnati a ƙasar Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi PSP e sa swanetše ke go tsenywa ka gare ga peakanyo ya mmušo ka Malawi.
Amharic: በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ አ.ሁ.እ አሁንም በማላዊ የመንግስት እቅዶች ውስጥ በተሻለ መልኩ መካተት አለበት፡፡

English: That is why in this book chapter, researchers report the history and application of PSP in Malawi.
Luganda: Ky’oba olaba nti mu ssuula y’ekitabo kino, abanoonyereza boogera ku byafaayo nkozesa y’Embeera y’Okuteekateeka omuli PSP mu Malawi.
Yoruba: Ìdí nìyẹn tí ó fi jẹ́ pé nínú ìwé yìí, àọn aṣèwádìí mẹ́nu ba ìtan àti ìlò PSP ní Malawi.
Zulu: Yingakho kulesi sahluko sencwadi, abacwaningi babika umlando nokusebenza kwe-PSP eMalawi.
Hausa: Wannan ne ya sa a cikin wannan babin littafi, masu bincike sun ba da rahoton tarihi da aiwatar PSP a ƙasar Malawi.
Northern Sotho: Ke ka lebaka leo ka mo gare ga kgaolo ye ya puku, banyakišiši ba bega ka ga histori le tirišo ya PSP ka Malawi.
Amharic: ለዛ ነው በዚህ የመጽሃፍ ምእራፍ ተመራማሪዎቹ በማላዊ የአ.ሁ.እን የጀርባ ታሪክ እና አተገባበር የሚዘግቡት፡፡

English: They showed how it can generate useful and credible information that would get even the most sceptical of farmers on board.
Luganda: Baalaga engeri gye kisobola okuleetamu obubaka obw’omugaso obusobola n’okuwaliriza abalimi abasinga okwekengera ne bakolera wamu ne bannaabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàfihàn bí ó ṣe lè pilẹ̀ àlàyé tí ó wúlò tí ó sì ṣe é fọkàn tán tí yóò mú àgbẹ̀ tí ó bá ń ṣe iyèméjì dara pọ̀ mọ́ ọn.
Zulu: Bakhombise ukuti ingakhiqiza kanjani ulwazi olunomsebenzi futhi oluthembekile olungenza ngisho abalimi abanongabazane ukuthi bajoyine.
Hausa: Sun nuna yadda zai iya samar da bayanai masu amfani da sahihanci waɗanda za su sa a yi tafiya tare da manoman da suka fi kowa shakku.
Northern Sotho: Ba laeditše ka fao e ka tšweletšago tshedimošo ya mohola le ye e tshephagalago le yeo e ka dirago gore balemi bao ba sa tshephego selo ba kgathe tema.
Amharic: እጅግ ተጠራጣሪ የሆኑ ገበሬዎችን ሳይቀር አሳምኖ በሚያስገባ መልኩ እንዴት ጠቃሚ እና ተማኝ መረጃን ማመንጨት እንደሚቻል አሳይተዋል፡፡

English: The researchers interviewed farmers from two out of 18 districts in Malawi that had experienced PSP over the last few years.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baabuuza abalimi ebibuuzo okuva mu disitulikiti bbiri ku ezo 18 ezikola Malawi abaali balina obumanyirivu ku nkola y’Embeera y’Okuteekateeka omuli PSP mu myaka emitonoto egiyise.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ní ìfọ̀rọlwánilẹ́nuwò pẹ̀lú àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n ní ìrírí PSP láti ọdún díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn ní agbègbè méjì nínú àwọn agbègbè 18 ní Malawì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bahlole izimvo zabalimi bezifundankantolo ezimbili kweziwu-18 eMalawi esezike zahlangana ne-PSP eminyakeni embalwa eyedlule.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattauna da manoma daga gundumomi biyu cikin 18 a ƙasar Malawi da suka fuskanci PSP a cikin 'yan shekarun nan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba botšišitše balemi dipotšišo ka dileteng tše pedi go tše 18 ka Malawi tšeo di itemogetšego PSP mo mengwageng ye mmalwa ye e fetilego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በማላዊ ባለፉት ቅርብ አመታት የአ.ሁ.እ ተሞክሮ ያላቸውን  ገበሬዎች ከ18 ክልልሎች በሁለቱ ቃለመጠይቅ አድርገዋል፡፡

English: Farmers in the districts of Karonga and Mulanje had been provided with seasonal climate forecasts through the PSP programme - researchers were particularly interested in these districts because they are located in the Northern Region and Southern Region where the forecasts are different.
Luganda: Abalimi okuva mu disitulikiti y’e Karonga ne Mulanje baaweebwa enteebereza y’embeera y’obudde ey’ebiseera ebimu okuva mu nteekateeka PSP – abanoonyereza baasigna kwagala disitulikiti zino kubanga ziri mu Kitundu ky’Obukiikakkono n’Obukiikaddyo omuli enteebereza y’obudde ey’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ti pèsè àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ nípa àkókó ojú-ọjọ́ fún àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n wà ní agbègbè Karinga àti Mulanje nípasẹ̀ ètò PSP - àwọn aṣèwádìí dojú kọ àwọn agbègbè yìí torí pé Apá Àríwá àti Gúuụsù níbi tí àsotẹ́lẹ̀ ti yàtọ̀ síra ni wọ́n wà.
Zulu: Abalimi kwizifundankantolo zase-Karonga kanye ne-Mulanje babeke bahlinzekwa ngeziqagulo zezikhathi zonyaka zobunjalozwe ngohlelo lwe-PSP - Abacwaningi babebheke kakhulu kulezi zifundankantolo ngoba zitholakala  eSifundeni saseNyakatho kanye naseSifundeni saseNingizimu lapho iziqaguli zihlukile.
Hausa: An samarwa da manoma a gundumomin Karonga da Mulanje hasashen yanayi na yanayi ta hanyar shirin PSP - masu bincike sun fi sha’awar waɗannan gundumomi ne saboda suna cikin yankin Arewa da Kudancin ƙasar inda hasashen ya sha banban.
Northern Sotho: Balemi ka dileteng tša Karonga le Mulanje ba filwe kakanyo ya tša tlelaemete ka ga dihla ka go diriša lenaneo la PSP – banyakišiši ba be ba tloga ba na le kgahlego ka mo dileteng tše ka gobane ba ka Seleteng sa ka Leboa le ka Seleteng sa ka Borwa fao dikakanyo di fapanego.
Amharic: በካሮንጋ እና በሙላንጄ ክልል የሚገኙ ገበሬዎች ወቅታዊ የአየር ንብረት ትንበያ በአ.ሁ.እ ፕሮግራም በኩል ደርሷቸው ነበር - ተመራማሪዎቹ  በተለይ እነዚህ ወረዳዎች ላይ የመስራት ፍላጎት ያደረባቸው ትንበያዎቹ በሚለያዩባቸው በሰሜን እና በደቡብ ክልሎች ውስጥ በመገኘታቸው ነው፡፡

English: The research report that PSP was most successful when farmers had interpretations of the climate information that the government produced in the form of advisories.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga omugaso gw’enkola ya PSP gwasinga kuviirayo awo abalimi we baataputira ebikwata ku mbeera y’obudde Gavumenti bye yali ebawadde mu ngeri y’okulabula.
Yoruba: Ìádìí náà fi yéni pé PSP kò kẹ́sẹ járí nígbà tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ fi òjò àlàyé ojú-ọjọ́ tí ìjọba ṣe gẹ́gẹ́ bí àlàyé gbinkà.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lubika ukuthi i-PSP yaba nempumelelo kakhulu ngenkathi abalimi benezihumusho zolwazi lobunjalozwe uhulumeni azikhiqizile ngohlobo lwezeluleko.
Hausa: Rahoton binciken ya nuna cewa PSP ya fi samun nasara lokacin da manoma suke da fassarar bayanan yanayi da gwamnati ta samar ta hanyar shawarwari.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di bega gore PSP e atlegile kudu ge balemi ba bile le ditlhathollo tša tshedimošo ya tlelaemete yeo mmušo o e tšweleditšego ka mokgwa wa dikeletšo.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንደሚዘግበው አ.ሁ.እ በደንብ የተሳካ የሚሆነው መንግስት ያዘጋጀው መረጃ በምክር መልኩ ተተርጉሞ ገበሬዎች ጋር ሲኖር  ነው፡፡

English: The researchers found that PSPis a good way to bridge the divide between science and society since farmers were able to communicate with experts in local languages.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti enkola ya PSP nnungi kubanga emalawo omuwaatwa wakati wa ssaayansi n’abantu ba bulijjo, ggwe anti abalimi baasobola okwogeraganya n’abakugu mu nnimi zaabwe enzaaliranwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí rí i pé ọ̀nà láti dín ìjìnnà síra tí ó wà láàrin sáyẹ́ńsì àti àwùjọ tó dára ni PSP níwọ́n ìgbà tí ọ̀rọ̀ tí àwọn akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ń fi èdẹ̀ abínibí sọ yé àwọn àgbẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi i-PSP iyindlela elungile yokuvala isikhala phakathi kwesayensi nopmphakathi, njengoba abalimi bekwazile ukuxhumana nochwepheshe ngezilimi zendawo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa PSP ita ce hanya mai kyau don cike rarrabuwar kawuna tsakanin kimiyya da al’umma tun da manoma sun sami damar yin magana da masana a cikin harsunan gida.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore PSP ke tsela ye kaone ya go fokotša sekgoba magareng ga tša mahlale le setšhaba ka ge balemi ba kgonne go boledišana le ditsebi ka dipolelo tša badudi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳገኙት ገበሬዎች በአካባቢያቸው ቋንቋ መነጋገር መቻላቸው አ.ሁ.እ በሳይንስ እና በማህበረሰቡ መካከል ያለውን ክፍተት ለማጥበብ የሚያስችል ጥሩ መንገድ ነው፡፡

English: PSP also helped women and the elderly to understand and use seasonal forests.
Luganda: Enkola ya PSP era yayamba abakayala n’abakadde okutegeera era n’okukozesa ebibira eby’ebiseera.
Yoruba: PSP tún ìránwọ́ fún àwọn obìnrin àti àwọn arúgbó láti ṣàmúlò àọn igbó kìjikìji tí wọ́n ní àkókó.
Zulu: i-PSP iphinde yasiza abesifazane kanaye nabadala ukuqonda nokusebenzisa amahlathi ezikhathi zonyaka.
Hausa: PSP ta kuma taimaka wa mata da tsofaffi don fahimta da kuma amfani da gandun daji na yanayi.
Northern Sotho: PSP e thušitše gape basadi le batšofadi go kwešiša le go šomiša dithokgwa tše di bago gona ka dihla tše itšego.
Amharic: አ.ሁ.እ በተጨማሪ ሴቶች እና አረጋውያን ስለደኖች እንዲረዱ እና እንዲጠቀሙ አግዟቸዋል፡፡

English: The researchers say PSP was best shared through direct messaging using multimedia communication.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola ya PSP yasinga kugabanibwa ng’eyitira mu ngeri y’okuweerezeganya obubaka obutereevu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé ọ̀nà tí àwọn gbà pín PSP tí ó dára jù ni líl àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ tààràtà lóri àwọn ikànnì ìbáraẹnisọ̀rọ̀ lọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi i-PSP ibisabalaliseka kahle kakhulu ngemiyalezo ngqo kusetshenziswa ukuxhumana kwe-multimedia.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce an fi raba PSP ta hanyar aika saƙon kai-tsaye ta amfani da sadarwar kallo da magana.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba re PSP e abilwe bokaone ka go diriša melaetša ya thwii ka go šomiša kgokagano ya kgašontši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚሉት አ.ሁ.እን ለመለዋወጥ የተለያዩ የሚዲያ መገናኛዎችን መጠቀም ምርጡ አማራጭ ነው፡፡

English: But while their report closes many critical gaps around how well PSP works, they caution that more research is needed to investigate the effects of NGOs and other actors sharing climate information with local farmers.
Luganda: Weewaawo nga alipoota yaabwe eziba emiwaatwa mingi ku bikwata ku nkola ya PSP, balabula nti okunoonyereza okusingako kwetaagisa okumanya ebiva mu Bitongole Binnakyewa (NGOs) nga bigabana obubaka obukwata ku mbeera y’obudde n’abalimi.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ bí èsì wọn ṣe ń di àwọn ààfò tí ó kanni lóminú nípa bi PSP ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́, wọ́n pè fún ìkóraẹni ní ìjánu pé wọ́n ṣì nílò ìwádìí síwájú sí i nípa ipa àwọn àjọ tí wọñ kì í se ti ìjọbaàti àwọn mìíràn tí wọ́n ń àlàyé nípa ojú-ọjọ́ ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn àgbẹ̀ ìgbèríkò.
Zulu: Kodwa ngenkathi umbiko wabo uvala izikhala eziningi ezibalulekile ekutheni i-PSP isebenza kahle kanjani, bayaxwayisa ukuthi ucwaningo oluthe xaxa luyadingeka ukuphenya imiphumela yama-NGO kanye nabaye abasabalalisa ulwazi lwezobunjalozwe nabalimi bendawo.
Hausa: Amma yayin da rahoton nasu ya rufe ɗimbin gibi da yawa game da yadda PSP take aiki, sun yi gargaɗin cewa ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike don bincika tasirin ƙungiyoyin Sa-kai da sauran masu ruwa da tsaki suna musayar bayanan yanayi tare da manoma na gida.
Northern Sotho: Eupša le ge pego ya bona e fokotša dikgoba tše ntši tše bohlokwa mabapi le ka fao PSP e šomago gabotse ka gona, ba eletša gore dinyakišišo tše ntši di a nyakega go nyakišiša diabe tša mekgatlo ye e sego ya mmušo(di- NGO) le bakgathatema ba bangwe bao ba abelanago tshedimošo ka ga tlelaemete le balemi ba tikologo.
Amharic: ዘገባቸው አ.ሁ.እ እንዴት እንደሚሰራ በመግለጽ ብዙ ወሳኝ ክፍተቶችን ቢዘጋም መንግስታዊ ያልሆኑ ድርጅቶች እና ሌሎች አካላት መረጃን ለአካባቢው ገበሬዎች በማካፈላቸው የሚፈጠሩ ተጽእኖዎችን ለመመርመር ተጨማሪ ምርምር እንደሚያስፈልግ ያሳስባሉ፡፡

English: In summary, PSP is still growing in Malawi, and has the potential to reach more districts, areas and villages.
Luganda: Mu bufunze, enkola ya PSP egenda ekulaakulana mu Malawi, era erina obusobozi okutuuka mu disitulikiti endala, mu bitundu ebirala ne mu byalo ebirala.
Yoruba: Ní kúkúrú, PSP ṣì ń gòkè ni Malawi, tí ó sì ní ipá láti dé àwọn agbègbè, àdúgbò, àti abúlé mìíràn sí i.
Zulu: Ukufingqa, i-PSP isakhula eMalawi, futhi inamathuba okufinyela kwezinye izifundankantolo, izindawo nezigodi.
Hausa: A taƙaice, PSP na ci gaba da girma a ƙasar Malawi, kuma tana da yiwuwar isa ga gundumomi, yankuna da ƙauyuka.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, PSP e sa gola ka Malawi, ebile e na le bokgoni bja go fihlelela dilete tše ntši, mafelo le metse.
Amharic: ባጠቃላይ አ.ሁ.እ በማላዊ እያደገ ሲሆን ብዙ ክልሎችን፣ አካባቢዎችን እና መንደሮችን የመድረስ አቅም አለው፡፡

Luganda: Abantu abawera bwe banaamanya enkola eya PSP, abantu abawera bajja kufuna obubaka obukwata ku mbeera y’obudde kibayambe okumanyiira obulabe obuva ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú bí àwọn ènìyàn tí mọ̀ nípa PSP bá ṣé ń pọ̀ sí i, ní àlàyé ní ojú-ọjọ́ yóò ṣe máa tó ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn lọ́wọ́ tí yóò sì máa ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti fi àyípa ojú-ọjọ́ kọ́ra.
Zulu: Ngoba abantu abengeziwe behlanagan ne-PSP, abantu abengeziwe bazokwazi ukuthola ulwazi ngobunjalozwe olusiza ukuthi bamelane nezingcuphe zokuguquka kobunjalozwe.
Hausa: Yayin da ƙarin mutane suka san PSP, ƙarin mutane za su sami damar yin amfani da bayanan yanayi waɗanda za su taimaka musu su daidaituwa da haɗarin sauyin yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge batho ba bantši ba tla kgona go fihlelela PSP, batho ba bantši le bona ba tla kgona go fihlellea tshedimošo ka ga tlelaemete yeo e ba thušago gore ba tlwaele dikotsi tša phetogo ya tlelaemete.
